name: Arved Harding
role: Senior Technical Associate, Eastman Chemical Company
bio: Arved Harding is a senior statistical associate at Eastman Chemical Company with over 30 years of experience applying statistics to various projects. He has experience in many areas including manufacturing, technology and services. Arved is a graduate of UVA Wise and VA Tech. He enjoys sharing his statistical knowledge and enthusiasm with others through teaching, speaking, and coaching others.
